settings.a: Yes. Delivery is free to mainland UK addresses, and our own team brings your bed to your door. If you are outside mainland UK, please contact us before ordering and we will confirm the options.

settings.q: How long will my bed take to arrive?
settings.a: Every bed is made to order. Most orders are delivered within 3–5 working days. We will contact you to arrange a delivery day that suits you.

settings.q: Can you make a bed in a custom size, fabric or design?
settings.a: Often, yes. Because we make every bed by hand, custom sizes, fabrics, colours, headboard heights and storage are usually possible. Send us a photo, sketch or description through our bespoke quote form and we will talk it through with you.

settings.q: Can I see the fabric before I order?
settings.a: Yes. Colours look different on every screen, so we post free fabric swatches. Request your swatches here.
